description: Environment variables for CostGuard Lambda function (Phases 1, 1.5, 2, and 3)

configuration.description: CostGuard - AWS Cost Management and Automated Prevention System

variableDescriptions.COST_DATA_TABLE: DynamoDB table for storing historical cost data (Phase 1)
variableDescriptions.FORECAST_CACHE_TABLE: DynamoDB table for caching AI-generated forecasts (Phase 2)
variableDescriptions.PREVENTION_CONFIG_TABLE: DynamoDB table for prevention system configuration (Phase 3)
variableDescriptions.RESOURCE_INVENTORY_TABLE: DynamoDB table for discovered resource inventory (Phase 3)
variableDescriptions.PREVENTION_AUDIT_TABLE: DynamoDB table for audit log of prevention actions (Phase 3)
variableDescriptions.APPROVAL_REQUESTS_TABLE: DynamoDB table for approval request tracking (Phase 3)
variableDescriptions.PREVENTION_ENABLED: Master switch to enable/disable prevention system (default: false for safety)
variableDescriptions.DRY_RUN_MODE: When true, log actions without executing them (default: true for safety)
variableDescriptions.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: When true, require approval before executing actions (default: true for safety)
variableDescriptions.APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: Minutes to wait for approval before timing out (default: 30)
variableDescriptions.BUDGET_POLL_INTERVAL_MINUTES: How often to poll budgets via EventBridge (default: 5)
variableDescriptions.RESOURCE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES: How often to refresh resource inventory (default: 15)
variableDescriptions.ACTION_THRESHOLD_PERCENT: Budget utilization % to trigger prevention actions (default: 90)
variableDescriptions.SNS_TOPIC_WARNINGS: SNS topic ARN for warning notifications
variableDescriptions.SNS_TOPIC_ACTIONS: SNS topic ARN for action notifications
variableDescriptions.SNS_TOPIC_ERRORS: SNS topic ARN for error notifications
variableDescriptions.BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: Amazon Bedrock model ID for AI forecasting (Phase 2)
variableDescriptions.ROLLBACK_WINDOW_HOURS: Hours within which actions can be rolled back (default: 24)

notes: PREVENTION_ENABLED defaults to false - must be explicitly enabled after validation
DRY_RUN_MODE defaults to true - monitor dry run reports before disabling
APPROVAL_REQUIRED defaults to true - gradually disable after confidence is built
All safety defaults follow the 'Safety First Approach' from the implementation plan
SNS topic ARNs use placeholders that will be replaced during deployment
Lambda timeout is 15 minutes (900 seconds) to allow for long-running prevention workflows
Memory is 512 MB to handle resource discovery across 20+ services
